page.title: Your profile
page.sub: Forms ask for these details again and again. Fill them in once here. Your resume can suggest updates, and nothing changes until you accept them.
page.notReady: Your profile isn't available yet. Please try again later.

profile.notResume: Your profile is separate from your resumes. Changing it never edits a resume.

completion.title: Complete your profile
completion.done: Your profile has everything forms usually ask for.
completion.why: Forms ask for these. Fill them once and they're ready every time.
completion.stepMissing: {count, plural, one {# thing missing} other {# things missing}}

actions.saveError: We couldn't save this. Check the highlighted fields and try again.

personal.headline: Headline
personal.headlineHint: One line about you, like "Data analyst with 5 years in retail".
personal.phoneInvalid: Enter the number with its country code, starting with +.
personal.summaryHint: A few sentences in your own words.

basics.intro: Recruiters at Chinese employers often ask for these. They're used to fill forms only.

statuses.left_available: Not working, can start any time
statuses.employed_within_month: Working, can start within a month

basics.optionalIntro: Some application forms ask for these. They're encrypted, used only to fill those forms, never used to rank jobs and never sent to AI.
basics.familyIntro: Only if a form you use asks for it.
basics.photoUnavailable: Photos aren't stored on this version of %BRAND%.

education.dateHint: Year, or year and month (2021 or 2021-09).

skills.intro: Skills you'd be comfortable being asked about in an interview.
skills.placeholder: Type a skill and press Enter

links.intro: Used to fill forms and to open people's profiles. Never used to rank jobs.
links.linkedinInvalid: Use your LinkedIn profile link, like https://www.linkedin.com/in/your-name
links.invalid: Enter a full link starting with https://

workAuth.intro: Answer for each country you'd like to work in. Forms ask these questions, and your answers help us flag jobs that say they can't sponsor a visa.
workAuth.authorized: Are you allowed to work in {country} without a new visa?
workAuth.sponsorship: Will you need an employer to sponsor a visa for {country}?

permits.citizen_or_resident: Citizen or resident, no permit needed
permits.work_permit_needed: The employer would need to apply for a work permit
permits.gold_card: I hold an Employment Gold Card

taiwan.intro: Taiwanese forms ask for these. They're your own answers and are used to fill forms.
taiwan.unavailable: Taiwan job preferences can't be saved yet. They'll be available soon.
taiwan.payInvalid: Give a lower or upper amount, with the lower one first.

answers.intro: Answers to common form questions, like notice period or expected salary, are kept with Ready to apply.

eeo.intro: Some US employers ask these optional questions. Your answers are encrypted, used only to fill those questions on forms, never used to rank jobs and never sent to AI. You can delete them at any time.
eeo.onlyUs: Shown because you'd like to work in the United States.
eeo.storedNotAsked: You saved answers to these questions earlier. Only US employers ask them, so they're not shown now. You can delete them here.

options.pacific_islander: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
options.not_veteran: I am not a protected veteran
options.yes: Yes, I have a disability (or had one)
options.no: No, I don't have a disability

eeo.deleteError: We couldn't delete these answers. Please try again.
eeo.notConfigured: These answers can't be saved right now. Please try again later.

sensitive.title: Sensitive answers
sensitive.intro: Answers some application forms ask for. They're encrypted, shown only to you, never used to rank jobs and never sent to AI.
sensitive.none: There are no sensitive questions to answer here.
sensitive.unreadable: Answers you saved earlier can't be read anymore. Enter them again to replace them, or delete them.
sensitive.openProfile: Edit the rest of your profile

sync.title: Update from a resume
sync.intro: Pick a resume. We'll show what it would change, and you choose what to keep.
sync.noResumes: You don't have a resume yet.
sync.nothing: Your profile already has everything this resume says.
sync.notRead: This resume hasn't been read yet, so there's nothing to compare. Try again in a minute.
sync.stale: Your resume or profile changed. Compare again.
sync.error: We couldn't do that right now. Please try again.
sync.resumeGone: This resume was deleted. Choose another one.
sync.neverRemoves: Nothing is removed from your profile.
